conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Vivek Sharma. Mera home loan ka foreclosure process kya hai?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Vivek ji, main aapko process samjhaata hoon. Kya aap apna loan account number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine check kiya. Foreclosure ke liye aapko outstanding amount aur charges pay karne honge. Main aapko exact amount aur process email karta hoon.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Yeh loan terms pe depend karta hai, lekin details email mein honge. 2 din mein process start kar sakte hain. Theek hai?
